note: Planning estimates for comparing architectures, owned by your platform team. They are not vendor quotes. Build effort is engineer-weeks for a first production release by a team that knows the stack.

vector_store.name: Vector store
vector_store.basis: a small managed vector store, e.g. an OpenSearch Serverless dev/test collection (about 1 OCU at $0.24/hour)

embeddings.name: Query embeddings
embeddings.basis: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 price per 1M tokens, one embedding per request

mcp_servers.name: MCP servers
mcp_servers.basis: a small always-on container per MCP server you host yourself (vendor-hosted servers cost nothing here)

cache.name: Response cache (Redis)
cache.basis: one small managed Redis node (e.g. Amazon ElastiCache cache.t4g.small at about $0.032/hour); holds millions of cached answers
